description: Transcribed manufacturer-specific PE100 water-pipe dimensional and mass data. Kept separate from the generic ISO reference dataset.

source.publisher: GF Piping Systems Indonesia / PT Georg Fischer Indonesia
notes: This file is a transcription of the named manufacturer's catalogue, not a universal availability list for all manufacturers or markets.
PN values are stated by the catalogue at 20°C with design coefficient 1.25; temperature derating is required.
A dash in the original table is represented by absence of a record, not by zero.
An asterisk in the source indicates availability should be confirmed with the manufacturer; the original note is preserved in availability_note where applicable.
Minimum wall thickness, average mass, OD tolerances and ovality are catalogue data. Do not replace them with OD/SDR ratio-derived nominal values.
